svg.text: Middleware checks a counter in Redis before letting a request through

g.text: Every request first hits the rate limiter middleware
Limiter knows the rule, e.g. 5 msgs/min per user (cached)
It increments the user's counter for the current window in Redis
Under the limit → forward to the API server
Over the limit → reject with 429 + Retry-After header
(Optionally) queue dropped work to process later
